trait.fallen_traits.rage.desc: Landing consecutive hits on the same target increases damage dealt. Stacks reset if the target hits back.
item.fallen_traits.rage_glove.desc: Melee attacks deal %s more damage per consecutive hit, up to %s total. Resets on being hit or after 10s of inactivity.
trait.fallen_traits.mimic.desc: Mob will wear the same equipment as the nearest player within %s blocks instead of randomly generated gear.
trait.fallen_traits.clone.desc: While engaged in combat, periodically creates illusion clones of itself. Clones die in one hit and explode when killed.
trait.fallen_traits.cleanse.desc: Periodically purges its own harmful effects and inflicts them on its current target instead.
trait.fallen_traits.berserk.desc: Boss attacks far more frequently and aggressively.
item.fallen_traits.invulnerability_break: Reduces hit targets' i-frames %s ticks. Increases your own by %s ticks when hurt.
trait.fallen_traits.infernal.desc: If a target strays too far for too long, the boss becomes Enraged: hitting harder, moving faster, and lunging at its target.
item.fallen_traits.fury_of_infernal.desc: Infernal and Berserk traits become compatible, can spawn together now
Mob Traits will be 100% more frequent
Gain %s damage per Trait Level the attacked enemy has (legendary not counted)
Each Legendary Trait level on the attacked enemy grants %s crit damage
Mobs with %s+ trait levels grant %s Attack Speed, %s per block away from the enemy
Mobs with %s+ trait levels grant %s Movement Speed, %s per block away from the enemy
trait.fallen_traits.devourer.desc: Steals %s of the damage it deals as permanent max health. Any healing within %s blocks is stolen instead, granted as overheal once past max health.
trait.fallen_traits.shredder.desc: Steals %s of a player's current armor with each hit and wears it as its own. Stolen armor is returned when the mob dies.
item.fallen_traits.titans_heart.desc_sta: Gain %s Size, %s Max Health, and %s Armor
item.fallen_traits.legendary_trait_cheap: Legendary Traits will be +%s more frequent
item.fallen_traits.law_of_scale.desc_dam: Deal up to %s current health damage to larger enemies, scaling with size difference
item.fallen_traits.law_of_scale.desc_kno: Knock back smaller enemies on hit, ignoring knockback resistance
item.fallen_traits.law_of_scale.desc_att: Gain %s Attack Speed for every 50%% smaller you are than your target
Gain %s Attack Damage for every 50%% larger you are than your target
item.fallen_traits.law_of_scale.desc_tra: Mobs will have %s more random traits
